items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: the drummer was the leader of the band -- a little cat named Bill Pinkert

ctx.x: And I'm working every night, right in the midst of it, and the guys would come back and say, "Hey, take a little snort of this" -- he said, "You won't get a habit" -- so I snorted it, and went back up on the bandstand, and the drummer was the leader of the band -- a little cat named Bill Pinkert, and he said, "Wilbur, wake up." I would say, "What do you mean, wake up?" You know, I had 2 fiddles, I had a bank account -- I didn't have to take this guff from this guy. Besides, he wasn't really caring if I played the…

And he kept doing it. I said, "Man, get you another bass player." And he said, "Wait a minute. We can sit down and talk about this." Oh, we were just smashed, and we were changing our uniform every intermission, and working steady. I said, "Now, don't tell me I'm sleeping on the bandstand. I don't want to work here no way." And all the guys in the band would say -- just 4 pieces -- would say I was nodding. "Me? I never nod." I didn't know. I didn't know what effect it had. I've seen the junkies out there, but I…
